title: 72-Hour Emergency Preparedness & Go-Bag Checklist
subtitle: Essential life-support supplies and documentation recommended by NDMA India for immediate disaster resilience.

items.label: Drinking water: At least 3 to 4 liters per person per day (minimum 3-day supply)
items.detail: Store in sealed food-grade containers; replace every 6 months. Crucial for hydration and sanitation.

items.label: Non-perishable ready-to-eat food (roasted gram, dry fruits, energy bars, biscuits, canned food)
items.detail: High-calorie foods requiring no cooking, heating, or refrigeration. Include manual can opener.

items.label: Water purification tablets (Chlorine / Halazone) or portable filtration bottle
items.detail: Allows safe purification of rainwater or clean surface water when municipal water fails.

items.label: Comprehensive First Aid Kit (sterile gauze, bandages, antiseptic solution, medical tape, scissors)
items.detail: Basic trauma management for cuts, punctures, sprains, and minor burns.

items.label: 7 to 14 days supply of essential personal prescription medicines
items.detail: Insulin, BP tablets, inhalers, heart medication, along with copy of doctor prescriptions.

items.label: Emergency OTC medications (Paracetamol, ORS rehydration sachets, antacids, antihistamines)
items.detail: ORS is especially vital during floods to counter diarrheal dehydration.

items.label: N95 masks / cloth dust filters (at least 2 per family member)
items.detail: Protects against pulverized concrete dust in earthquakes and debris fumes in landslides.

items.label: LED Flashlight / Torch with extra sealed batteries or crank dynamo
items.detail: Crucial for night navigation; avoid open candles which cause post-quake fires.

items.label: High-decibel emergency whistle (pea-less safety whistle)
items.detail: Saves energy and voice when trapped; whistle sound travels 3x further through debris than shouts.

items.label: Fully charged heavy-duty power bank (10,000–20,000 mAh) with charging cables
items.detail: Keeps mobile phones operational for emergency SOS texts and geolocation beacons.

items.label: Battery-operated portable FM/AM radio
items.detail: Receives official All India Radio (AIR) civil defense bulletins when cell towers fail.

items.label: Multi-purpose pocket knife / utility tool (pliers, screwdriver, can opener)
items.detail: Assists with utility valve shutoff, cutting rope, and equipment repairs.

items.label: Waterproof zip-lock pouch containing copies of Aadhaar, Passport, Insurance, Property deeds
items.detail: Keep photocopies and an encrypted USB drive with digital scans.

items.label: Emergency cash in small denominations (₹100, ₹200, ₹500 notes)
items.detail: ATMs and digital payment networks (UPI) will be non-functional during widespread power outages.

items.label: Laminated card with printed emergency contacts (Family, Doctors, Local Police, DDMA)
items.detail: Essential when smartphones run out of battery or are water-damaged.

items.label: Sturdy closed-toe shoes or gumboots and heavy-duty work gloves
items.detail: Protects against shattered glass, nails, broken masonry, and contaminated mud.

items.label: Lightweight raincoat/poncho and emergency thermal space blanket
items.detail: Prevents hypothermia from wind, monsoon rains, and overnight exposure.

items.label: Sanitary napkins, soap, hand sanitizer, antiseptic wet wipes, and small towel
items.detail: Prevents skin infections and maintains hygiene in crowded community shelters.
